annotation.title_clean: Polityka dla rozwoju sztucznej inteligencji w Polsce od roku 2020
annotation.title_en: Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of Ministers of Poland (Ministry of Digital Affairs)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Poland's national AI policy, adopted by Council of Ministers resolution of 28 December 2020. Sets short-, medium- and long-term objectives across six areas: society, innovative companies, science, education, international cooperation and the public sector. It emphasises innovation, skills, data, sandboxes and human dignity, with no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Objectives set for 2023, 2027 and beyond across six areas
Digital regulatory sandboxes and financing for Polish AI companies
Opposes granting legal personality to AI; liability by diligence for developers and risk for operators
AI education and retraining for workers threatened by automation
Excludes national security and defence; aligned with EU and OECD ethics standards
